title: AlgebraicGeometry.affineBasisKInjectiveSections_preservesLeftHomology
statement: For an integer-indexed K-injective complex F on a scheme X and an affine open V, if positive cohomology of every homology sheaf restricts to affine opens W contained in V vanishes, evaluation on V preserves the left homology data of F in every degree. The complex and module sheaves are those of [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; cohomology is [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor] and the scheme is [def-pc-scheme]. K-injectivity is [def-pur-kinjective-complex].

proof.text: Apply the lower-tail vanishing theorem in degrees n and n+1 to the part of QF strictly below n. Apply derived sections to the canonical truncation triangle. Since both endpoint homology objects vanish, the homology exact sequence makes H^n of the canonical lower-truncation projection an isomorphism.

Use the derived lower-truncation cycle formula. Its bottom comparison is a specified isomorphism carrying the cycle lift, the raw-to-derived unit and the canonical truncation projection to S of the homology quotient. K-injectivity makes the raw-to-derived unit invertible, and the previous step makes the projection invertible. The preserved cycle kernel gives mappedCyclesHomologyData, whose cokernel-to-homology isomorphism identifies its cokernel projection with the cycle lift followed by the section homology quotient.

Compose these specified isomorphisms. The cycle formula says that the resulting isomorphism out of the cokernel of S(h.f-prime) sends its cokernel projection to S(h.pi). Transport the cokernel universal property along that isomorphism. Together with preservation of the cycle kernel this preserves the chosen left homology data, and Functor.PreservesLeftHomologyOf.mk-prime yields the result.

proof_origin.place: Tags 071B and 08C2; lower-tail vanishing isolated, canonical cycle formula and cokernel transport implemented in Lean

theorem affineBasisKInjectiveSections_preservesLeftHomology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ) [F.IsKInjective]
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1))) (n : ℤ) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    S.PreservesLeftHomologyOf (F.sc n)
